# 0.6.1 beta 2 — Clear presence choices and timing-aware automatic control

- Give the device presence choices explicit names: no presence restriction,
  only while the room is occupied, and only while the room is empty. Explain
  each choice in the controller help and guide, including unknown presence
  and confirmed whole-home absence. Existing selections retain their meaning.
- Account for both minimum ON and minimum OFF times when planning binary PID
  cycles. Extend a feasible cycle to retain the requested duty instead of
  silently reducing its ON share when the minimum OFF period is longer than
  the original OFF window. Automatic commands still use observed device
  transitions and respect the configured operating minimums.
- Display separate room-info explanations on separate lines, including Greek
  text. Keep information readable when several reasons are present.
- Close an open info bubble when clicking elsewhere, including outside the
  card. Clicking within the bubble keeps it open; its existing toggle remains
  available.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard.
No presence selections or device operating times are reset. Existing releases,
assets, and tags are retained.
